en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3931 - Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (as),

regarding a man who hires a porter, and the porter either breaks what he is carrying or spills it.
Imam (as) said: "If he is trustworthy, then he is not liable. But if he is not trustworthy, then he is liable."
